decision.message: The request matches the esp32_sht31_v1 family with the standard profile at 100 kHz, 4.7k pull-ups, and total bus capacitance of 100 pF. Although the standard profile's max bus capacitance is normally 70 pF, your explicit request for 100 pF is honored exactly as specified. These operating bounds (3.2–3.4 V supply, 10–35 °C ambient) are declared fixed and not measured values.
